title: The beginning of God’s creative work

verses.1: In the beginning God created the Heavens and the earth.
verses.2: And the earth was without form, and void; darkness lay over the deep, and the Spirit of God moved over the waters.
verses.3: And God said, "Let there be light," and light came to be.
verses.4: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God separated the light from the darkness.
verses.5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night; and evening came, and morning followed—the first day.
verses.6: And God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, bringing separation among the waters."
verses.7: And God made the firmament, and separated the waters beneath the firmament from the waters above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.8: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day
verses.9: And God said, "Let the waters beneath the heavens be gathered to one place, and let the dry land appear." And it was so.
verses.10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
verses.11: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth vegetation—plants yielding seed, and fruit trees bearing fruit according to their kind, whose seed is in them—upon the earth." And it was so.
verses.12: And the earth brought forth vegetation—plants yielding seed according to their kind, and trees bearing fruit whose seed is in them according to their kind. And God saw that it was good
verses.13: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
verses.14: And God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs and for appointed times, and for days and years."
verses.15: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heavens, to give light upon the earth. And it was so.
verses.16: And God made the two great lights—the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He made the stars also.
verses.17: And God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light upon the earth,
verses.18: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.19: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
verses.20: And God said, "Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that has life, and let birds fly above the earth across the firmament of the heavens."
verses.21: And God created the great sea creatures, and every living creature that moves, with which the waters abounded, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.22: And God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."
verses.23: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
verses.24: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind: livestock, creeping thing, and beast of the earth, according to its kind." And it was so.
verses.25: And God made the beast of the earth according to its kind, and livestock according to its kind, and everything that creeps upon the ground according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.26: And God said, "Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth."
verses.27: So God created man in His image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
verses.28: And God blessed them, and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moves upon the earth."
verses.29: And God said, "Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant that is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food."
verses.30: "And to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creeps upon the earth, in which is the breath of life, I have given every green plant for food." And it was so.
verses.31: And God saw everything that He had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
